Report stems whose raw plot spelling disagrees with their tag range

dot-flag_small_tree_name_mismatches.Rd

Every stem carrying the same plot_plot_name_old value was entered as one quadrat in the field, so they should all land in the same quadrat once assigned by tag. Where a spelling straddles two quadrats, the rows in the smaller share are the suspicious ones — either the tag or the trailing underscore was mistyped.

Usage

.flag_small_tree_name_mismatches(trees)

Arguments

trees

Assigned tree data frame (plot_name, plot_name_raw).

Value

Data frame of the minority rows, or NULL when every spelling is consistent.
